question: Does adding true transverse context reduce the error and grid-aligned oscillation of the normal-only 2-D HCFL model?

variants.normal6wide: capacity control: normal six-cell input with width 90 and exactly the same 10,804 parameters as flat18
variants.flat18: single MLP over all 3x6 primitive cells; transverse relevance is learned without a structural gate
variants.gated18: six-cell normal branch plus zero-compatible transverse residual gate; exact reduction when all three rows agree

official_quadrant_role: post-hoc diagnostic only; never used for selection because it was already observed
capacity_control_amendment: normal6wide was added after flat18 validation began but before any new test or official-quadrant evaluation; it is an adversarial attribution control, not a selectable transverse method
interpretation_limit: A later confirmatory experiment requires newly generated validation and held-out oblique/quadrant cases.
